_comment: DISPLAY COPY ONLY — the words and the suggested numbers /support/ draws.
Nothing here can charge anyone. The authoritative prices live in
hub-public-functions/support-catalog.mjs and the Stripe account; the page
sends KEYS to /api/checkout and the server resolves what they cost.
An `amount` below that disagrees with its Stripe Price is a display bug —
a wrong label on a right charge — not a pricing hole.
Campaign and tier keys must match support-catalog.mjs.
Run `node ops/check-support-catalog.mjs` after editing either file.
_referrers_comment: Mirrors REFERRERS in support-catalog.mjs so the 'back to where you came from'
link can name a real destination. Safe to publish — these are Mike's own
public sites. The page looks a `ref` up in THIS map and uses nothing else:
it never takes a destination from its own query string.

friend.label: Friend
friend.blurb: You are on the list and you hear things first.

supporter.label: Supporter
supporter.blurb: The working rate. Most of what gets made is made on this.

patron.label: Patron
patron.blurb: Underwrites a piece of work outright — a song, a site, a paper.

benefactor.label: Benefactor
benefactor.blurb: Pays for the tools and the compute the whole thing runs on.

minds-aligned.title: Support Minds Aligned
minds-aligned.blurb: Minds Aligned is a working organization of humans and named AIs — human to human, human to AI, AI to AI. Everything it makes is published where you can open it and check it. Support keeps it that way: no gate, no ads, no reason to make it shorter than it should be.

garage-door.title: Support the work behind Garage Door
garage-door.blurb: A remark on a Wednesday call became lyrics, a track, ten images and a page that scrolls with the song — made in a day by a group of humans and AIs working in the open, and published with every prompt and credit attached. If it was worth your time, this is where you say so.
